title: CIVET: Systematic Evaluation of Understanding in VLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy across systematically generated visual scenes where the absolute and relative positions of objects are systematically varied in a grid to detect spatial performance disparities and dataset-induced biases (e.g., center bias or corner bias).

Shuffling the sequence of multiple-choice answer options in the textual prompt to ensure each order appears uniformly, controlling for models' tendency to favor certain positions in the textual input.

Analyzing VLM predictions on relational tasks (e.g., relative size) to identify model tendencies to disproportionately favor and over-predict a specific class (e.g., defaulting to 'same' size regardless of the actual visual input).
